"

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable offline MOBA prototype with an isometric single-lane map, Blue and Red bases, a movable hero, and a destructible Red tower.

## Requirements
- Right-click movement, with a virtual joystick for mobile.
- Clicking/targeting the Red tower makes the hero approach and auto-attack until it is destroyed.
- Keep visuals simple with basic shapes or placeholders.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a dependency-free browser game using Canvas 2D and CSS-drawn HUD; no external game engine or art assets.
- Added attack button and `A` keyboard shortcut alongside tower clicking; added a victory screen and restart action.
- Removed Google Fonts dependency so the prototype works offline.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the isometric battlefield, bases, hero, tower, HP bar, HUD, minimap, mobile joystick, targeting, auto-attacks, and victory/restart flow.
- Verified `game.js` syntax with `node --check`.
- Tested tower destruction through the attack button in Playwright; HUD reached `Destroyed • 0% integrity` and victory overlay appeared.
- Captured and inspected the latest screenshot at `screenshots/riftbound.jpg` at mobile viewport size.

### Active
- No active implementation work; the user’s build request has been addressed.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Optionally inspect `git status` and report the completed build and basic assumptions to the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game structure and HUD.
- `style.css`: Responsive HUD, minimap, victory overlay, and joystick styling.
- `game.js`: Canvas rendering and movement/combat gameplay.
- `screenshots/riftbound.jpg`: Latest inspected mobile viewport capture.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local HTTP server was started for browser testing; Playwright used the installed Chrome channel after its default Chromium browser was unavailable.
